Ms. Sharmila S. Kaushik, APP for the Respondent - State.
CORAM : NITIN W. SAMBRE, J.

DATE : 22nd DECEMBER, 2021 P.C.
1.
Heard.

2. Learned APP waives notice.
3.

In view of the fact that the Apex Court has stayed the order of quashing in the matter of Anand Chaurasiya in SLP preferred by the State of Maharashtra, the doubt is raised on the applicability of Section 328 of the IPC to the facts of the present case.
4. In that view of the matter, adjourned to 14 th February, 2022.
